experiment.name: Human severe-malaria blood signatures (neutrophil granule, type 1 interferon) in the B. rossi Beagle transcriptome (DS06)
experiment.description: Do the whole-blood signatures of severe human malaria appear in the five experimentally infected Beagles before clinical deterioration, and earlier at the high dose? Hypothesis: both set scores rise from day 0 to the last pre-treatment sample beyond the library composition shift, first in the high-dose dogs.
experiment.summary: Type 1 interferon score rose from day 0 to the last pre-treatment sample in 5 of 5 Beagles (4 beyond the composition background; sign-test p 0.062); neutrophil granule in 5 of 5 (4 beyond background, p 0.062); n 5 dogs, 1 source, exploratory. 0 of 2 sign tests below 0.05 (minimum attainable 0.0625). 'Earlier at the high dose' not met (interferon no, neutrophil no).

sections.heading: Question
paragraphs: Do the whole-blood signatures of severe human malaria (neutrophil granule and type 1 interferon genes) rise in the five B. rossi Beagles between day 0 and the last sample before treatment, before clinical deterioration, and earlier at the high dose?

sections.heading: What was done
paragraphs: DS06 whole-blood RNA-seq (12,362 genes, 28 samples; 5 dogs with a time course). Genes were ranked inside each sample; a set score is the mean rank percentile of its genes. Mapped genes: neutrophil granule 6 of 11, type 1 interferon 11 of 11, erythroid control 2 of 3. Not in the matrix: MPO, ELANE, OLFM4, CEACAM8, ARG1, HBB.

The primary result is the change per dog from day 0 to day 4 (day 3 for high_3, which died on day 4), compared with 2,000 random gene sets matched on day-0 expression, because the day 3 and day 4 libraries collapse and shift to reticulocyte transcripts. Timing used the DS02 habitus score; the DS06-to-DS02 dog mapping is probable only for high_3 and unverified for the others, so it was run under both possible mappings inside each dose group. Days 6 and 8 follow treatment and are shown only.

sections.heading: Result
paragraphs: Type 1 interferon: higher than day 0 in 5 of 5 dogs (sign-test p 0.062), beyond the composition background in 4 of 5. Per dog: low_1 +0.305 (background percentile 1.00); low_2 +0.422 (background percentile 1.00); high_1 +0.174 (background percentile 1.00); high_2 +0.027 (background percentile 0.77); high_3 +0.386 (background percentile 1.00). The signature appears.

Neutrophil granule: higher in 5 of 5 dogs (p 0.062), beyond background in 4 of 5. Per dog: low_1 +0.102 (background percentile 0.96); low_2 +0.130 (background percentile 0.99); high_1 +0.167 (background percentile 1.00); high_2 +0.276 (background percentile 1.00); high_3 +0.190 (background percentile 1.00). The signature appears.
Erythroid control: higher in 5 of 5 dogs, beyond background in 5 of 5 (the reticulocyte shift).

Timing (working mapping). Interferon: low_1: risen day 3, habitus fell day 4; low_2: risen day 1, habitus fell day 4; high_1: risen day 1, habitus fell day 2; high_2: risen day 1, habitus fell day 2; high_3: risen day 1, habitus fell day 3. Neutrophil granule: low_1: risen day 3, habitus fell day 4; low_2: risen day 3, habitus fell day 4; high_1: risen day 1, habitus fell day 2; high_2: risen day 4, habitus fell day 2; high_3: risen day 1, habitus fell day 3. Risen before deterioration in at least one dog: interferon yes (alternative mapping yes), neutrophil granule yes (alternative yes). Earlier at the high dose: interferon no, neutrophil granule no.

Pre-treatment day of the highest score (D1, D3, D4): interferon low_1 day 4; low_2 day 4; high_1 day 1; high_2 day 1; high_3 day 3; neutrophil granule low_1 day 4; low_2 day 4; high_1 day 4; high_2 day 4; high_3 day 3. The spec rule for 'earlier at the high dose' needs every high-dose dog to rise before both low-dose dogs; it is not met.

Construct checks (median of per-dog Spearman rho over 3 or 4 pre-treatment points, working mapping): interferon score with plasma IP-10 +1.00, neutrophil-granule score with band neutrophils +0.80, erythroid score with reticulocyte % +1.00.

sections.heading: What this does not show
paragraphs: Five dogs from one experiment (one source) show a pattern, not a rate: no sign count can reach p < 0.05. Dose is aliased with dog, and the dog mapping to the clinical data is unverified except for high_3. It does not show that these genes mark severe natural babesiosis, that they predict anything, or that the human malaria signatures transfer: several neutrophil granule genes (the promyelocyte genes) are not in the pre-filtered matrix. No genome-wide screen was run.
